description.en:
Writes a match flag that CMND_BTL_GET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG reads back. Going by its name ("faul" is the developers' spelling), the flag was meant to stop forced outcomes from producing fouls.
In the code traced, though, nothing but GET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG reads it. The match also rewrites it on its own: while it updates the pitch display, it sets the flag to 1 when either team's goalkeeper is in the forced-win list (filled by CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN), and to 0 when neither is. So a value written here does not last. Match setup also resets it to 0.
The only shipped use is btl0003.nut: true when the match begins, false in its result callback.
true (non-zero) to set the flag, false to clear it.
Always null (also when no argument is given).

examples.case: Set at kick-off, cleared at the result (real usage, from btl0003.nut)
